replies.root_cause: IP MTU mismatch on the Gi0/0/2 segment: local 1500 vs core 9100 after CHG-21877. OSPF DBD packets advertise the interface MTU, the neighbor with the larger MTU is rejected, and the adjacency never leaves EXSTART/EXCHANGE. Fix: align MTU (mtu 9100 / ip mtu 9100 locally, or revert the core) - 'ip ospf mtu-ignore' only hides the problem.
